race.comment: IT STAYS IN VEGAS (1) gets the nod after going within a nose of Bonoyster at Quirindi over 1000m, and that second-up improvement was a clear step in the right direction. The 3kg claim helps offset the 64kg with the good 1000m record. Assess off the Class 2 run at Scone first up. UNALIENABLE RIGHT (6) is the danger with winning form, having fought out a narrow Mdn success at Beaumont (Newcastle) and now arrives race fit, though the 1000m is still a small query on his exposed record. EEZITOSORT (4) brings the most reliable profile, with a close Class 1 third at Muswellbrook and a long-neck second at this track the run prior. Her track-and-distance record keeps her right in contention. SUPIDO STAR (3) struck trouble at the start and anchored with the 59kg second up with a tiring last in a Class 1 over 1000m at Muswellbrook. Bullock sticks and look for a better showing.
